claims.claim: Clients have 10 business days to upload intake documents.
claims.evidence_quote: Clients must upload requested documents within 10 business days of receiving the intake link.

claims.claim: Expenses exceeding $800 need a second review.
claims.evidence_quote: Expenses above $800 require a second review before the case can move to preparation.

claims.claim: PDF, PNG, and JPG are accepted upload formats.
claims.evidence_quote: Accepted upload formats are PDF, PNG, and JPG.

claims.claim: A named case owner is required before handoff to preparation.
claims.evidence_quote: A named case owner is required before an intake packet moves to preparation.

claims.claim: Supervising reviewers can approve documented exceptions.
claims.evidence_quote: Only a supervising reviewer can approve an exception to the missing-document policy.

claims.claim: All upload failures are resolved automatically without human review.
claims.evidence_quote: All upload failures are resolved automatically without human review.
